description: Call this first, except for make_cartoon. One topic of Jabbertoon's guide as Markdown (under 20,000 characters): start (what it makes, the order of calls, every other topic), cartoon (the JSON program), text (a cartoon as screenplay text), song (the editor's film file: lines, moves, shots, choreography, words on the picture), build (the 3D builder), export (STL, 3MF, glTF, SVG, Minecraft), world (a 3D world built from inside, as in Minecraft), game, motion (movement written as words, jabbertoon.com/motion/). x and y are shares of the stage (0 to 1, ground 0.92); times are seconds. Example: {"topic": "cartoon"}.

topic.description: Leave it out for start, which names the others.

name: get_guide
title: Read Jabbertoon's guide for writing a cartoon
